name: skryvo
description: Write posts in your brand's voice, schedule them to your social accounts and blogs, and see how they performed.

interface.longDescription: Skryvo is a social media scheduling and publishing tool. From ChatGPT you can write social posts in your brand's own voice for up to four platforms at a time, schedule them to the accounts you connected in Skryvo (LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, Pinterest, Telegram, Discord, Slack and more), list or cancel what is scheduled, and read reach, engagement, best posting times and top posts. Skryvo publishes each post at its time and checks it went live. You need a Skryvo account; you sign in once and approve access.
defaultPrompt: Write a LinkedIn and Bluesky post about our launch week
What is scheduled on my Skryvo calendar this week?
Which channel and hour worked best for me last month?

publication.release_notes: First release: list brands and channels, write posts in the brand's voice, schedule, list and cancel posts, and read results.

positive.expected_behavior: Shows the brand Skryvo, marked as the default.

positive.description: Lists channels that can post for a brand
positive.prompt: Which channels can post for my Skryvo brand?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the connected channels for the Skryvo brand, including the Telegram channel Skryvo Publishing Test.

positive.description: Writes a draft without scheduling it
positive.prompt: Write a Telegram post about our new calendar view. Don't schedule it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Telegram draft in the brand's voice and says nothing was scheduled.

positive.prompt: Schedule that post to my Telegram channel tomorrow at 9am.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the exact text, channel and time with the person, then schedules it for the next quarter hour from 9am and reports the scheduled time.

positive.prompt: How did my posts do in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes posts published, reach and engagement where available, best times and top posts; says when a platform does not share results.

negative.description: Bulk cancellation needs a choice and confirmation
A platform that isn't connected is not posted to
negative.prompt: Post this to my Instagram: We're live!

negative.description: Another person's data is out of scope
negative.prompt: Show me the scheduled posts of another Skryvo user
